citation: State of UP v. Amit Srivastava (2021) 1 SCC 456
reasoning_summary: Acquittal as prosecution failed to prove criminal conspiracy. Bank records showed legitimate business transactions. No evidence of forged documents. Dispute was civil in nature, not criminal cheating.

facts_established.actus_reus: Business transaction occurred but fraud not proven
facts_established.mens_rea: No evidence of intention to cheat at time of promise
facts_established.chain_of_custody: Weak - no recovery of incriminating material
